description: Premium "fix this dependency upgrade" report for moving package X from version A to B: breaking changes from every release note, the project's migration guide, changed runtime/peer requirements, vulnerabilities fixed or introduced, problems others hit after upgrading (GitHub issues, Stack Overflow), and a cited step-by-step upgrade plan. Price: $0.10 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). Paid only (not in the free trial).
